source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The folder adapter stores folder identity on each row and collects chosen folders by walking every child, even when ancestors are closed. Its setter adds choice flags and opens ancestors; it does not clear old flags on a later assignment. The owned flag is folderSelected; accepted code uses checked. The checked offline and virtual-folder callers each initialize a new adapter once, then consume the chosen set on acceptance. Unit source checks selection after collapsing ancestors, not repeated assignment, mutation or actual dialog/accessibility behavior. No test ran.
title: Folder-picker choices include hidden descendants and are initialized separately from visible rows
